digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions bridge workflows and core push integration
propositions: Both bridge workflow inline CAS loops and reconciler raw-git exemption must be removed, delegating commit-and-push to core strict synchronous adapters
Reconcile-bridge workflow must preserve bot identity and commit subject while invoking exactly one core push entrypoint with strict delivery and synchronous red failure
Reconcile-bridge-canary workflow must delegate to rebar._store.push as a strict push-only synchronous action with no inline fetch/merge/retry
Core owns retry and CAS recovery; workflows remain red on exhausted delivery while Python library and MCP retain best-effort defaults
Tests must confirm absence of inline loops, single core push invocation per workflow, strict synchronous behavior, preserved red disposition, and updated fixture rationale
